mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_supplier_reconcile_record ( groupid, supplier_id, supplier_name, company_name, reconcile_month, order_count, total_order_amount, total_received, total_paid_amount, total_unpaid_amount, total_invoiced_amount, total_uninvoiced_amount, reconcile_by, reconcile_time ) VALUES ( #{groupid}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{companyName}, #{reconcileMonth}, #{orderCount}, #{totalOrderAmount}, #{totalReceived}, #{totalPaidAmount}, #{totalUnpaidAmount}, #{totalInvoicedAmount}, #{totalUninvoicedAmount}, #{reconcileBy}, #{reconcileTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_supplier_reconcile_record SET supplier_name = #{supplierName}, company_name = #{companyName}, order_count = #{orderCount}, total_order_amount = #{totalOrderAmount}, total_received = #{totalReceived}, total_paid_amount = #{totalPaidAmount}, total_unpaid_amount = #{totalUnpaidAmount}, total_invoiced_amount = #{totalInvoicedAmount}, total_uninvoiced_amount = #{totalUninvoicedAmount}, reconcile_by = #{reconcileBy}, reconcile_time = #{reconcileTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, groupid, supplier_id AS supplierId, supplier_name AS supplierName, company_name AS companyName, reconcile_month AS reconcileMonth, order_count AS orderCount, total_order_amount AS totalOrderAmount, total_received AS totalReceived, total_paid_amount AS totalPaidAmount, total_unpaid_amount AS totalUnpaidAmount, total_invoiced_amount AS totalInvoicedAmount, total_uninvoiced_amount AS totalUninvoicedAmount, reconcile_by AS reconcileBy, reconcile_time AS reconcileTime, created_time AS createdTime, updated_time AS updatedTime FROM fin_supplier_reconcile_record WHERE groupid = #{groupid} AND supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND reconcile_month = #{reconcileMonth} ORDER BY reconcile_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, groupid, supplier_id AS supplierId, supplier_name AS supplierName, company_name AS companyName, reconcile_month AS reconcileMonth, order_count AS orderCount, total_order_amount AS totalOrderAmount, total_received AS totalReceived, total_paid_amount AS totalPaidAmount, total_unpaid_amount AS totalUnpaidAmount, total_invoiced_amount AS totalInvoicedAmount, total_uninvoiced_amount AS totalUninvoicedAmount, reconcile_by AS reconcileBy, reconcile_time AS reconcileTime, created_time AS createdTime, updated_time AS updatedTime FROM fin_supplier_reconcile_record WHERE groupid = #{groupid} AND supplier_id = #{supplierId} ORDER BY reconcile_time DESC LIMIT 1
